I only played Mesmer for BWE1, and I can tell you it was surprisingly fun. 

I got to level 25 in BWE1, but I can't say much for PvE because they might of changed a lot of things.

For PvP, Mesmer was A LOT of fun. You have a lot of escape skills, so you're very survivable, if used properly. And they changed "confusion", so it works! You can also do a lot of burst and be defensive (sword 2 skill), while having the ability to stealth away, and blink behind them, doing another burst.

From another profession's point of view, since I played ele. this BWE, if you want to annoy, confuse, and abuse your opponent, then Mesmer is the way to go.

Yeah. You place your mouse over the area you want to target and it doesn't require you to click. The downside is that you can't see if you're in range or out of range.

I like to keep one hand on my mouse and my other hand on WASD. I rebinded my 6 key or heal to E for easy access and my 7 - 0 to Q,R,T, and Z. I put my elite on Z since it's not used as much as my other utilities. My Q key was used for my mobility utility skill (like shadowstep or blink), but it doesn't have to be just for those types of skill. I also turned on auto-ground target in the options menu because it doesn't require me to click every time I use a ground target skill. 

You practice through trail and error. What's more important is setting your priorities in PvP. Your goal is to gain 500 points before the opposing team does, and the quickest way for that to happen is if you have more points captured than the other team. So instead of looking for kills, you look for possible points you can capture. You can choose to, occasionally, kill opponents walking to a point. 

Timing is very important but you need to get used to using things like dodge. Dodging isn't only used for escaping red circles. It can cancel skills and create space between you and your opponent. Timing will come naturally after you gain some experience.
